tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Knowasiak, a public network of 14,000+ businesses and business owners, for businesses, people and posts, or (type "help") its help guides on how the site works. Returns ids to read in full with fetch, with a short snippet and the public URL of each.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one Knowasiak profile, post or help guide in full, as Markdown, by the id from search (e.g. "profile:AdityaGaurav", "post:36405" or "help:discover-people"), or by its knowasiak.com address. A profile includes its links and recent posts; a post its replies.

tools.name: find_businesses
tools.description: Find businesses on Knowasiak that do something, optionally in a country or city. Use it when someone wants a supplier, agency, service provider or partner.

tools.name: latest_posts
tools.description: The newest public posts on Knowasiak, optionally about a topic.

tools.name: discover_people
tools.description: Knowasiak's Discover: people and businesses worth following, each with why they were picked, plus who follows whom among them. With no arguments on a signed-in connection, the member's own suggestions. Give similar_to (a username) for "Show similar": people like that profile. Give followers_of or fo

tools.name: person_details
tools.description: What Knowasiak's Discover panel says about one profile: a sentence on why they are worth knowing (their industry, how often they post, how many people found their posts useful and where, people in common on a signed-in connection), a few facts, and whether the member follows them. tools.name: people_map
tools.description: The Knowasiak people map: the places with the most members or businesses, at city level (or a country, for members without a city), optionally only those in one industry or here for one reason, with how many each industry and reason has. tools.name: people_in_place
tools.description: Members or businesses in one city (or country) on the Knowasiak map, with what they do and what they are here for. On a signed-in connection, people the member follows or who follow them come first.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, person_details · Public sink: fetch, person_details.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, person_details · Public sink: fetch, person_details

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
